title: Instruction transition action
statement: Given an instruction with $m$ registers and $d$ available deciders, a label, a phase, an optional Boolean input symbol, and the current contents of each register, define the corresponding one-step action of a machine whose states are pairs of labels and phases. The action is determined by the instruction and phase, with the specified instruction transitions and the default inactive action in the remaining cases.
hypotheses_covered: Natural numbers of registers $m$ and deciders $d$
Register contents assigning each register either no bit or a Boolean bit
caveat: Several transition helpers used by this definition are absent from the supplied snippet, so their precise tape effects and branches cannot be fully rendered from the provided ground truth.
